blocks.text: Oklahoma City guard Jalen Williams will need surgery to repair a broken left fibula and dislocated left ankle, the latest significant blows to a Thunder franchise that has dealt with a number of injury-related issues in recent seasons. There isn’t a timetable for Williams’ return and one won’t be set until after the surgery, general manager Sam Presti said Monday — but given the history of such injuries, it’s reasonable to think Williams could miss the rest of the season. “Dub, as everybody knows, is as tough as they come,” Presti said at a news conference in Oklahoma City, where the […]...
